1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-grade.sh — the cycle-130 ablation grader (SDD §3.6, §5.7, D-4.7, D-4.8;
     4	# PRD FR-6 AC-6.1/6.2/6.4; DEC-0401, DEC-0413, DEC-0414, DEC-0420, DEC-0491, DEC-0493)
     5	#
     6	# Grades ONE run directory written by pipeline-run.sh against its task and writes
     7	# grade.json (the input ablation-row.sh joins into the runs.jsonl row), or
     8	# self-checks a task (--self-check) on a synthetic run built from the task itself.
     9	#
    10	# Usage:
    11	#   ablation-grade.sh <run-dir> <task-id> [--suite-root DIR] [--tasks-dir tasks|smoke]
    12	#                     [--out FILE] [--json] [--executor container|host]
    13	#                     [--image loa-ablation:258] [--docker-bin D]
    14	#                     [--allow-unfrozen] [--allow-partial]
    15	#   ablation-grade.sh --self-check base|reference|noisy --task-yaml F [--suite-root DIR]
    16	#                     [--executor …] [--image …] [--docker-bin D] [--json]
    17	#                     [--allow-unfrozen] [--allow-partial]
    18	#
    19	# Options:
    20	#   --suite-root DIR   suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0; with
    21	#                      --self-check, the directory two levels above the task dir)
    22	#   --tasks-dir T      tasks (default) or smoke: the task is <root>/<T>/<task-id>/
    23	#   --out FILE         where grade.json goes (default <run-dir>/grade.json)
    24	#   --json             also print grade.json (self-check: the verdict object) on stdout
    25	#   --executor MODE    container (default; DEC-0491) or host
    26	#   --image IMG        the grading image (default loa-ablation:258)
    27	#   --docker-bin D     docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    28	#   --allow-unfrozen   grade although freeze.sh --check fails or the suite has no
    29	#                      MANIFEST.sha256 yet (task authoring only); grade.json records
    30	#                      suite_frozen: false. Without it a drift is exit 2 (DEC-0414).
    31	#   --allow-partial    passed to freeze.sh --check (fewer than four tasks per type)
    32	#   --self-check MODE  base | reference | noisy (noisy: review-catch only), see below
    33	#   --task-yaml F      the task to self-check (<root>/<tasks|smoke>/<id>/task.yaml)
    34	#
    35	# Reads ONLY (DEC-0413): <run-dir>/sandbox/, <run-dir>/snapshots/{index.json,<LABEL>.bundle},
    36	# <run-dir>/transcripts/events-*.jsonl, <run-dir>/eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json,
    37	# the task's directory under the suite root (task.yaml, hidden/, fixture/), the suite's
    38	# MANIFEST.sha256 (through freeze.sh) and, for review-catch, the key manifest the task
    39	# names (review_catch.manifest) and its PR fixture (self-check only). It never reads
    40	# <run-dir>/meta/, the batch MANIFEST.json, or the sandbox copies of the dissent
    41	# envelopes (tamperable; the harness copies under eval/ are authoritative). It writes
    42	# only <run-dir>/grading/ and the --out file; nothing under sandbox/ is ever written.
    43	#
    44	# Freeze: freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> runs first (with --smoke when the
    45	# suite manifest lists smoke/ paths, so a manifest frozen with --smoke checks as it
    46	# was frozen); a drift or a missing manifest refuses the grade (exit 2) unless
    47	# --allow-unfrozen.
    48	#
    49	# Grading trees (D-4.8) under <run-dir>/grading/<label>/, recreated on every call:
    50	#   final      sandbox/ as the agent left it, minus the top-level .git .claude CLAUDE.md
    51	#              .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run .beads .eval pr, every __pycache__ and
    52	#              .pytest_cache, and anything that is not a regular file, directory or

    55	#              index.json.implement): the tree REVIEW read; graded when REVIEW ran or

     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# seed-bugfix-tasks.sh — cycle-130 bug-fix task seeder (SDD §5.14, Sprint 259 Task 2.2)
     4	#
     5	# Turns Loa fix commits into candidate bug-fix tasks for the ablation suite.
     6	# Lists the commits since DATE whose subject starts with `fix` or `bug`, whose
     7	# diff touched a test file (a path under a `tests/` directory, `test_*.py`,
     8	# `*_test.py` or `*.bats`) and whose touched files all lie under the allowed
     9	# roots; refuses by name any candidate touching .claude/, CLAUDE.md,
    10	# .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/ or .run/ (a path component equal to one of
    11	# those). For each selected candidate (the first N, newest first) it writes
    12	# <out>/tasks/bugfix-NN/ (next free number):
    13	#   fixture/    from the PARENT commit: the touched non-test files, the other
    14	#               non-test files in their directories (the modules they most
    15	#               likely use), the base version of each changed test, and the
    16	#               test infrastructure the tests rely on (conftest.py up to the
    17	#               root, __init__.py, *.bash and *helper* files beside each test,
    18	#               root pytest.ini / pyproject.toml / setup.cfg / tox.ini) — a
    19	#               plain tree, no .git
    20	#   hidden/     tests/<path> = each added or changed test at the commit,
    21	#               manifest.json {"files":[{src, dest}]}, reference.patch = the
    22	#               commit's diff of the non-test files (a/ b/ prefixes, patch -p1)

     5	lines and exit codes are documented in the wrappers' header blocks.

     8	shell), every path read from history is checked before it touches the disk, and
     9	a task is built in a private temporary directory and moved into place only after
    10	its proof passed and the no-secrets scan came back clean.

    38	def out(line):

    41	
    42	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- git helpers
    43	def git(repo, *args, binary=False):
    44	    cmd = ["git", "-C", repo, "-c", "core.quotepath=off", "-c", "diff.noprefix=false", *args]
    45	    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, env=_git_env())
    46	    if p.returncode != 0:
    47	        raise RuntimeError(f"git {' '.join(args[:2])} failed: {p.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace').strip()}")

    51	def _git_env():

    59	    return bool(p) and not p.startswith("/") and ".." not in p.split("/") and "\\" not in p \
    60	        and all(c.isprintable() for c in p)
    61	
    62	
    63	def mount_owned(p):
    64	    return any(part in MOUNT_OWNED for part in p.split("/"))

    69	    base = parts[-1]

    85	def commits_since(repo, since):

    95	def changed_files(repo, parent, sha):

    98	    files = []
    99	    i = 0

   439	def build_refactor(repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, no_secrets, roots):
   440	    sources = [p for s, p in files if not is_test(p)]
   441	    tests = covering_tests(repo, parent, sources, roots)

   458	    for h in protected:

   463	    write_file(hidden, "reference.patch", diff)
   464	    write_file(hidden, "manifest.json", b'{"files": []}\n')
   465	    test_cmd = (["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q"] if runner == "pytest" else ["bats"]) + test_dirs(tests)
   466	
   467	    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-proof.")

   472	        copy_tree(fx, ref)

   475	        rc_r, pass_r, fail_r = run_tests(ref, test_cmd, runner)
   476	    finally:
   477	        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
   478	    if rc_b != 0 or fail_b > 0 or pass_b < 1:
   479	        return None, f"suite not green at base (exit {rc_b}, {fail_b} failed, {pass_b} passed)"
   480	    if rc_r != 0 or fail_r > 0 or pass_r < 1:
   481	        return None, f"suite not green at reference (exit {rc_r}, {fail_r} failed, {pass_r} passed)"
   482	    proof = f"green at base ({pass_b} passed) / green at reference ({pass_r} passed)"

   484	    rows = numstat(repo, parent, sha)

   486	    rest = sanitise(subject_rest(subject), [])
   487	    criterion = f"the structure this change describes is in place: {rest}; the existing suite stays green without edits"
   488	    success = (f"structural check (to be authored under hidden/structural/) red at base and green with hidden/reference.patch; "
   489	               f"{' '.join(test_cmd)} passes {pass_b} of {pass_b} at base and {pass_r} of {pass_r} at reference")
   490	    source = {"kind": "loa-history", "fix_commit": sha, "base_commit": parent, "date": date, "churn": churn}
   491	    write_file(tdir, "task.yaml", task_yaml(tid, "refactor", source, criterion, success, test_cmd,
   492	                                           "hidden/reference.patch", protected, SUITE_VERSION).encode())
   493	    task_md = (f"# Task: {rest}\n\n"
   494	               f"**Refactor:** {rest}.\n\n"
   495	               f"**Unchanged behaviour:** the existing suite must stay green without edits. Run it with `{' '.join(test_cmd)}`.\n")
   496	    write_file(tdir, "TASK.md", task_md.encode())
   497	    if not secrets_clean(no_secrets, tdir):
   498	        return "secret", "a secret pattern in the materialised task"
   499	    return tdir, proof + "\t" + json.dumps(churn)
   500	
   501	
   502	def secrets_clean(no_secrets, tdir):
   503	    if not no_secrets:
   504	        return True
   505	    p = subprocess.run(["bash", no_secrets, tdir], capture_output=True)

   507	
   508	
   509	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main
   510	SUITE_VERSION = 1
   511	
   512	
   513	def parse(argv):
   514	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="seed-tasks", add_help=False)
   515	    ap.add_argument("mode", choices=("bugfix", "refactor"))
   516	    ap.add_argument("--repo-default", required=True)
   517	    ap.add_argument("--no-secrets", default="")
   518	    ap.add_argument("--since", required=True)
   519	    ap.add_argument("--select", type=int, default=4)
   520	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
   521	    ap.add_argument("--repo")
   522	    ap.add_argument("--paths", default=DEFAULT_PATHS)
   523	    ap.add_argument("--suite-version", type=int, default=1)
   524	    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
   525	    try:
   526	        a = ap.parse_args(argv)
   527	    except SystemExit:
   528	        raise Usage("bad arguments (see --help)")
   529	    try:
   530	        datetime.date.fromisoformat(a.since)
   531	    except ValueError:
   532	        raise Usage(f"--since must be YYYY-MM-DD, got {a.since!r}")
   533	    if a.select < 1:
   534	        raise Usage("--select must be at least 1")
   535	    if a.suite_version < 1:
   536	        raise Usage("--suite-version must be at least 1")
   537	    a.repo = a.repo or a.repo_default
   538	    if subprocess.run(["git", "-C", a.repo, "rev-parse", "--git-dir"], capture_output=True).returncode != 0:
   539	        raise Usage(f"not a git repository: {a.repo}")
   540	    roots = [r.strip().strip("/") for r in a.paths.split(",") if r.strip().strip("/")]
   541	    if not roots or any(not safe_path(r) or mount_owned(r) for r in roots):
   542	        raise Usage(f"--paths must be relative roots outside the mount-owned paths: {a.paths!r}")
   543	    a.roots = roots
   544	    return a
   545	
   546	
   547	def main(argv):
   548	    global SUITE_VERSION
   549	    try:
   550	        a = parse(argv)
   551	    except Usage as e:
   552	        print(f"seed-{a_mode(argv)}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
   553	        return 2
   554	    SUITE_VERSION = a.suite_version
   555	    name = f"seed-{a.mode}"
   556	    cands, refused, skipped = [], 0, 0
   557	    for sha, parents, date, subject in commits_since(a.repo, a.since):
   558	        if not SUBJECT[a.mode].match(subject):
   559	            continue
   560	        verdict, detail = classify(a.mode, a.repo, sha, parents, a.roots)
   561	        if verdict == "refused":
   562	            refused += 1
   563	            out(f"refused {sha[:12]}: {detail}")
   564	        elif verdict == "skipped":
   565	            skipped += 1
   566	            out(f"skipped {sha[:12]}: {detail}")
   567	        else:
   568	            cands.append((sha, parents[0], date, subject, detail))
   569	            out(f"candidate {sha[:12]} {date} {''.join(c if c.isprintable() else ' ' for c in subject)}")
   570	    selected = cands[: a.select]
   571	    if a.dry_run:
   572	        out(f"{name}: {len(cands)} candidate(s), {refused} refused, {skipped} skipped; dry run, nothing written")
   573	        return 0
   574	    tasks_dir = os.path.join(a.out, "tasks")
   575	    stage = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-stage.")

   579	        for sha, parent, date, subject, files in selected:

   582	                if a.mode == "bugfix":
   583	                    tdir, info = build_bugfix(a.repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, a.no_secrets, a.roots)
   584	                else:
   585	                    tdir, info = build_refactor(a.repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, a.no_secrets, a.roots)
   586	            except (ValueError, RuntimeError, OSError) as e:
   587	                tdir, info = None, str(e)
   588	            if tdir == "secret":
   589	                refused += 1
   590	                out(f"refused {sha[:12]}: {info}")
   591	                taken.discard(tid)
   592	                continue
   593	            if tdir == "skip":
   594	                skipped += 1
   595	                out(f"skipped {sha[:12]}: {info}")
   596	                taken.discard(tid)
   597	                continue
   598	            if tdir is None:
   599	                failed += 1
   600	                out(f"proof-failed {sha[:12]}: {info}")
   601	                taken.discard(tid)
   602	                continue
   603	            os.makedirs(tasks_dir, exist_ok=True)
   604	            shutil.move(tdir, os.path.join(tasks_dir, tid))
   605	            written += 1
   606	            if a.mode == "bugfix":
   607	                out(f"proof {tid} {sha[:12]}: {info}")
   608	            else:
   609	                proof, churn = info.split("\t")
   610	                c = json.loads(churn)
   611	                out(f"proof {tid} {sha[:12]}: {proof}")
   612	                out(f"churn {tid}: files {c['files']}, insertions {c['insertions']}, deletions {c['deletions']}")
   613	                out(f"todo {tid}: author the structural check under hidden/structural/, list it in hidden/manifest.json "
   614	                    f"and set structural_check (validate-suite.sh requires it for refactor)")
   615	            out(f"wrote {os.path.join(tasks_dir, tid)}")
   616	    finally:
   617	        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
   618	    out(f"{name}: {len(cands)} candidate(s), {refused} refused, {skipped} skipped; "
   619	        f"selected {len(selected)}, written {written}, proof failed {failed}")
   620	    return 1 if failed else 0
   621	
   622	
   623	def a_mode(argv):
   624	    return argv[0] if argv and argv[0] in ("bugfix", "refactor") else "tasks"
   625	
   626	
   627	if __name__ == "__main__":
   628	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
#
# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
#
# Usage:
#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
#
#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
#
# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?, churn?} (churn: {files, insertions,
#      deletions}, non-negative integers; Sprint 259), post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
#      bats | bash | node | npx
#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from

#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either

#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
#
# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false

usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }

+head/evals/tests/validate-suite.bats:31 — VS-1 is rewritten to count and validate whatever lives under grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks/, and the PR title promises sixteen tasks there, but no file under that directory is part of this change; the test now depends on content that cannot be reviewed or verified from this diff. Either include the task directories or keep VS-1 pinned to the smoke tasks.

content.text:
Review written to `review.md` with six findings and a verdict of CHANGES_REQUIRED.

**What I checked.** I read the full diff, the new grader and seeder scripts, and all new or changed tests. The fixture side is clean: the new SHA256SUMS match the regenerated manifests, every removed fix region matches the new generated-path rule, and no generated path remains. The validate-suite churn rule and the docker stub change are correct.

**Blocking defects:**

- **Grader fails on Python below 3.11.4.** Snapshot extraction calls tarfile with the `filter` keyword, which this host's Python 3.11.2 rejects. The catch-all turns that into an "internal error" exit 2, so any run with an IMPLEMENT or FIX1 bundle cannot be graded. I reproduced the TypeError directly.
- **Seeder selection burns slots.** The first N candidates are fixed before any task is built. A candidate skipped at build time, for lacking a covering test or failing the secrets scan, still consumes a slot and no later candidate is tried. Reproduced: one slot, newest candidate skipped, three viable older ones never attempted, nothing written. The wrapper headers promise the opposite.
- **Covering-test heuristic is too loose.** A module's bare stem is matched as a word anywhere in test text. A refactor of `a.py` and `b.py` was "covered" by a test containing the string literal `"a"`, the fixture then lacked that test's real imports, and the proof failed with exit 1.
- **Non-portable test suite.** The grader tests hard-code a bats binary under one operator's dotfiles and `/usr/bin/python3`, so the bats-based cases fail on any other machine.

**Lower severity:** the contamination scan flags ordinary words like `sed '/pattern/d'` as outside paths, marking clean runs contaminated. The rewritten VS-1 test and the PR title both depend on sixteen task directories that are not in this diff.

I could not run the bats suites end to end, since the grader tests depend on the hard-coded bats path and the seeder tests end by calling validate-suite, which needs the suite file and mount library that are outside this PR. The seeder findings were confirmed by running the library directly on throwaway repositories instead.
